🛠 Dashboard Developer Workbench
Form: {{FormName}}
Explore schema metadata, indexes, field coverage, sample data and dashboard readiness for any Helix IS or AR System form.
options.defaultContent: The query didn't return any results.

sourceQuery.rawQuery: SELECT name AS FormName FROM `AR System Metadata: arschema` where schemaType <> 4 and name = $FormList limit 1

SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS CustomFields
FROM `AR System Metadata: arschema` S
INNER JOIN `AR System Metadata: field` F
    ON F.`schemaId` = S.`Schema ID`
WHERE S.`name` = ${FormList}
AND F.`fOption` = 2
AND F.`overlayProp` > 0

SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT indexName) AS IndexCount
FROM `AR System Metadata: arschema` S
INNER JOIN `AR System Metadata: schema_index` I
    ON I.`schemaId` = S.`Schema ID`
WHERE S.`name` = ${FormList}
and I.overlayGroup = '0'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS FieldCount
FROM `AR System Metadata: arschema` SCM
LEFT OUTER JOIN `AR System Metadata: field` F1
    ON F1.`schemaId` = SCM.`Schema ID`
WHERE F1.fOption = 2
AND datatype IN (1,2,3,4,6,7,8,9,10)
AND SCM.name = ${FormList}
AND SCM.overlayGroup = '0'
--AND (F1.overlayProp > 0 OR $FieldTypes = 'All')

SELECT
    S.`name`,
    S.`Schema ID` AS FormID,
    I.`numFields`,
    I.`indexName`,
    F1.`fieldName` AS field1_name,
    F2.`fieldName` AS field2_name,
    F3.`fieldName` AS field3_name,
    F4.`fieldName` AS field4_name,
    F5.`fieldName` AS field5_name,
    F6.`fieldName` AS field6_name,
    F1.`fieldName`
        + CASE WHEN F2.`fieldName` IS NOT NULL THEN ':' + F2.`fieldName` ELSE '' END
        + CASE WHEN F3.`fieldName` IS NOT NULL THEN ':' + F3.`fieldName` ELSE '' END
        + CASE WHEN F4.`fieldName` IS NOT NULL THEN ':' + F4.`fieldName` ELSE '' END
        + CASE WHEN F5.`fieldName` IS NOT NULL THEN ':' + F5.`fieldName` ELSE '' END
        + CASE WHEN F6.`fieldName` IS NOT NULL THEN ':' + F6.`fieldName` ELSE '' END
        AS Indexes
FROM `AR System Metadata: arschema` S
LEFT JOIN `AR System Metadata: schema_index` I
    ON S.`Schema ID` = I.`schemaId`
LEFT JOIN `AR System Metadata: field` F1
    ON F1.`schemaId` = S.`Schema ID`
    AND F1.`fieldId` = I.`f1`
LEFT JOIN `AR System Metadata: field` F2
    ON F2.`schemaId` = S.`Schema ID`
    AND F2.`fieldId` = I.`f2`
LEFT JOIN `AR System Metadata: field` F3
    ON F3.`schemaId` = S.`Schema ID`
    AND F3.`fieldId` = I.`f3`
LEFT JOIN `AR System Metadata: field` F4
    ON F4.`schemaId` = S.`Schema ID`
    AND F4.`fieldId` = I.`f4`
LEFT JOIN `AR System Metadata: field` F5
    ON F5.`schemaId` = S.`Schema ID`
    AND F5.`fieldId` = I.`f5`
LEFT JOIN `AR System Metadata: field` F6
    ON F6.`schemaId` = S.`Schema ID`
    AND F6.`fieldId` = I.`f6`
WHERE S.`name` = $FormList

SELECT
  SCM.`name`,
  SCM.`Schema ID` AS FormID,
  IDX.`numFields`,
  IDX.`indexName`,
  --IDX.`f1`,
  F1.`fieldName` AS field1_name,
  --IDX.`f2`,
  F2.`fieldName` AS field2_name,
  --IDX.`f3`,
  F3.`fieldName` AS field3_name,
  --IDX.`f4`,
  F4.`fieldName` AS field4_name,
  --IDX.`f5`,
  F5.`fieldName` AS field5_name,
  --IDX.`f6`,
  F6.`fieldName` AS field6_name
FROM `AR System Metadata: arschema` AS SCM
LEFT JOIN `AR System Metadata: schema_index` AS IDX
  ON SCM.`Schema ID` = IDX.`schemaId`
LEFT JOIN `AR System Metadata: field` AS F1
  ON F1.`schemaId` = SCM.`Schema ID` AND F1.`fieldId` = IDX.`f1`
LEFT JOIN `AR System Metadata: field` AS F2
  ON F2.`schemaId` = SCM.`Schema ID` AND F2.`fieldId` = IDX.`f2`
LEFT JOIN `AR System Metadata: field` AS F3
  ON F3.`schemaId` = SCM.`Schema ID` AND F3.`fieldId` = IDX.`f3`
LEFT JOIN `AR System Metadata: field` AS F4
  ON F4.`schemaId` = SCM.`Schema ID` AND F4.`fieldId` = IDX.`f4`
LEFT JOIN `AR System Metadata: field` AS F5
  ON F5.`schemaId` = SCM.`Schema ID` AND F5.`fieldId` = IDX.`f5`
LEFT JOIN `AR System Metadata: field` AS F6
  ON F6.`schemaId` = SCM.`Schema ID` AND F6.`fieldId` = IDX.`f6`
WHERE SCM.`name` = $FormList  -- or use ? and bind parameter, or 'literal'

select * from `AR System Schema`.`${FormList:raw}` OurForm
limit $Rows Offset $Offset

SELECT 
    F.`fieldId` AS FieldID,
    F.`datatype` AS DataType,
    F.`fieldName` AS DBFieldName,
    DP.`label` AS FieldLabel,
    V.`vuiName` AS ViewName,
    F.`overlayGroup` AS FieldOverlayGroup,
    F.`overlayProp` AS FieldOverlayProp,
    DP.`overlayGroup` AS DispOverlayGroup,
    V.`overlayGroup` AS VUIOverlayGroup,
    F.`resolvedfieldId` AS ResolvedFieldID,
    F.`resolvedName` AS ResolvedName
FROM `AR System Metadata: arschema` AS SCM
LEFT OUTER JOIN `AR System Metadata: field` AS F
    ON F.`schemaId` = SCM.`Schema ID`
LEFT OUTER JOIN `AR System Metadata: field_dispprop` AS DP
    ON DP.`schemaId` = F.`schemaId`
    AND DP.`fieldId` = F.`fieldId`
LEFT OUTER JOIN `AR System Metadata: vui` AS V
    ON V.`schemaId` = DP.`schemaId`
    AND V.`vuiId` = DP.`vuiId`
WHERE SCM.`name` = ${FormList}
AND V.`vuiName` = ${View:singlequote}
AND F.`fOption` = 2
AND F.`datatype` IN (1,2,3,4,6,7,8,9,10,12,13,14)
AND SCM.`overlayGroup` = '0'
and V.`overlayGroup` = '0'
AND DP.overlayGroup = '0'
order by DBFieldName asc
